channel.title: RemoteKazi Jobs
channel.description: Latest jobs in Kenya and remote jobs open to Kenyans

item.title: Multiple Positions at The Canopy Hotel - The Canopy Hotel (Other Kenya)
item.description: The Canopy Hotel, which opened on November 7, 2025, is hiring for several roles. Open positions include Receptionist/Front Desk Officer (2), Housekeeping/Hospitality Assistants (8), Spa & Wellness Attendant (2) and Bartender (1), along with a Waiter role.

item.title: Remote Image Annotators - CloudFactory (Remote)
item.description: CloudFactory is hiring remote image annotators. The company is looking for sonographers, ultrasound technologists and other medical imaging professionals with hands-on ultrasound experience. CloudFactory provides an on-demand digital workforce for business processes in the cloud.

item.title: Relationship Manager - Minet Kenya (Other Kenya)
item.description: Minet Kenya is hiring a Relationship Manager. Minet describes itself as a pan-African advisor offering risk and human capital solutions, and it is the largest Aon Global Network Correspondent with access to over 50,000 colleagues in 120 countries.

item.title: Customer Service Champion - Choux Bakery (Other Kenya)
item.description: Choux Bakery is hiring a Customer Service Champion with 2 years of customer service experience in a sales-based role. Applicants should work well in a busy environment, show strong attention to detail and apply customer service principles. Applications with a CV and portfolio go to jobs@chouxbakery.

item.title: Driver - World Vision Kenya (Other Kenya)
item.description: World Vision Kenya is hiring a Driver to support program staff with transport. The role also involves keeping the organisation's fleet safe and healthy.

item.title: Program Accountant - International Livestock Research Institute (ILRI) (Other Kenya)
item.description: ILRI is a CGIAR research centre that works to improve food security and reduce poverty in developing countries through research on sustainable use of livestock. The Program Accountant role covers financial accounting, reporting and donor compliance.

item.title: Job Vacancies at County Government of Kitui – Multiple Positions - County Government of Kitui (Other Kenya)
item.description: The County Government of Kitui has listed multiple job vacancies, including openings for Youth Polytechnic. Kitui County lies 170 km south east of Nairobi and covers about 30,496 km2.

item.title: Multiple Positions at Ride & Trend - Ride & Trend (Other Kenya)
item.description: Ride & Trend is a Kenyan motor vehicle company that directly imports new and used vehicles from Japan, the UK, Australia and Thailand. It handles sourcing, importation, clearing and delivery to clients in Kenya. Receptionist is one of the roles listed among its open jobs.

item.title: Nutrition Intern - Action Against Hunger (Other Kenya)
item.description: Action Against Hunger is a nonprofit working in 55 countries on hunger prevention and treatment programs, reaching 28 million people each year. It is offering a Nutrition Intern position in Kenya.

item.title: Part-Time Enumerator - Village Enterprise (Other Kenya)
item.description: Village Enterprise is recruiting part-time enumerators in its Programs department, reporting to the MEL Associate. Listed locations are Busia, Kisumu, Kakuma and Isiolo. The organisation works to end extreme poverty in rural Africa through entrepreneurship, innovation and collective action.

item.title: Available Vacancies at President's Award-Kenya (PA-K) - President's Award-Kenya (PA-K) (Other Kenya)
item.description: The President's Award-Kenya (PA-K) is an agency established under the President's Award Act No. 30 of 2017. It runs experiential activities that teach life skills and ethical values to young people. Open roles include Accountant II and Senior Programmes.

item.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO) - Bank of Africa Kenya Limited (Other Kenya)
item.description: Bank of Africa Kenya Limited, a commercial bank serving corporate, SME and retail clients, is hiring a Data Protection Officer. item.title: Swahili Language Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer - Meridial (Remote)
item.description: Meridial is looking for Swahili language experts to work on a freelance project training AI language models. The work involves producing high-quality training data to help AI serve Swahili speakers in areas such as education, research and communication.

item.title: Associate Field Manager – Call Center - GiveDirectly (Other Kenya)
item.description: GiveDirectly is a nonprofit that sends money directly to people living in extreme poverty. This fixed-term contract role is for an Associate Field Manager in the call center. Responsibilities include performance management, such as holding weekly 1:1 check-ins with assigned staff.

item.title: Human Resource Officer - Freedom Airline (Nairobi)
item.description: Freedom Airline, trading as Freedom Airline Express Ltd, is hiring a Human Resource Officer. The airline is based in Nairobi, was established in 2008 and is licensed to operate across Africa and the Middle East.

item.title: Junior Software Engineer - Science Lab Limited (Other Kenya)
item.description: Science Lab Limited is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to build and maintain software for its internal operations and customer-facing products. The role covers work across the stack, from backend APIs and databases to frontend interfaces, with guidance from senior colleagues.

item.title: Marketing Specialist - Forward Push (Remote)
item.description: Forward Push, a law firm marketing company headquartered in the United States, is hiring a remote full-time Marketing Specialist open worldwide. item.title: Job Openings at United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) - United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) (Other Kenya)
item.description: UNEP is the leading global environmental authority within the United Nations system. The listing mentions an open position for a Programme Management Assistant at grade G6.

item.title: Data Manager - Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) (Kisumu)
item.description: Kenya Medical Research Institute (KEMRI) is hiring a Data Manager in Kisumu. KEMRI is a state corporation responsible for carrying out national health research in Kenya. The role's responsibilities include designing, developing and reviewing data systems.

item.title: Accounts Receivables - PrideInn Hotels, Resorts & Camp (Other Kenya)
item.description: PrideInn Hotels, Resorts & Camp is a Kenyan hospitality brand founded 12 years ago. It operates 8 hotels and a camp across Nairobi, Machakos, Narok, Mombasa and Kwale counties, with over 1,000 employees.

item.description: Metropolitan Hospital is hiring an Executive Driver to provide safe, punctual, discreet and professional transport for hospital management and other authorised passengers. The role also involves keeping the assigned vehicle well maintained.

item.description: KCB Bank Kenya is hiring a Solution Architect. The bank is a licensed institution under Kenya Commercial Bank Limited, a holding company that also oversees KCB units in Uganda, Tanzania, Rwanda, Burundi, Ethiopia and South Sudan.

item.title: Sales Representative - Hihome (Nairobi)
item.description: Hihome, a consumer electronics brand focused on smart living, is hiring a Sales Representative in Nairobi. item.description: Peoplelink Consultants Ltd is hiring a Quality Controller in Kenya. Duties include checking that quality checks are complete for the allocated shift, carrying out step-by-step release, and monitoring and recording held WIP and finished crowns and closures.

item.title: Customer Experience Associate – Yard Operations - Peach Cars KE (Other Kenya)
item.description: Peach Cars KE is hiring a Customer Experience Associate for its yard operations. The company runs an e-commerce platform and automotive marketplace for locally-used vehicles in sub-Saharan Africa.

item.description: Yellow Pages Kenya is a digital agency offering print, online and digital services, with over 30 years in business. It operates in several countries including Angola, Mozambique and Tanzania, and is hiring an IT/Software Specialist.

item.title: Intern – Field Engineering – 2027 - Baker Hughes (Nairobi)
item.description:
Baker Hughes is hiring an Intern – Field Engineering – 2027 in Nairobi, Nairobi Municipality.
How to apply: use the Apply button to go to the employer's page.

item.title: Customer Service Representative - Q-Sourcing Servtec Group (Other Kenya)
item.description: Q-Sourcing Servtec Group is hiring a Customer Service Representative in Kenya. The role aims to uphold the bank's image and reputation and maintain strong customer relationships through accurate transaction processing and efficient service delivery.

item.description: Afia Concept Claims Settling Agency (ACS) is a healthcare consulting firm headquartered in Nairobi, operating in East Africa. It offers services in healthcare facility design, health financing advisory, digital health and operational management. The listing mentions an open Head of Finance position.

item.description: Corporate Staffing Services is hiring a middle-level Accountant in Nairobi to manage daily financial operations, payroll, inventory and statutory compliance. Applicants need a Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance, CPA(K) and at least 5 years of accounting experience.

item.description: Ramco Group is hiring a Procurement Officer to coordinate and carry out the purchasing of fabrics, trims, garment accessories, production materials and other operational needs. item.title: ICT Officer, Network Administration - Postbank (Other Kenya)
item.description: Postbank (Kenya Post Office Savings Bank) is hiring an ICT Officer for network administration. The role manages the corporate network infrastructure, including firewalls, routers and switches. item.description: The Jacaranda Nairobi Hotel in Westlands is hiring a Junior Store Clerk. The role involves being in charge of the respective stores and checking stock expiry dates, then advising the Stock Controller.

item.description: KCA University is hiring an Administrative Assistant for its Directorate of Teaching Practice & Industrial Attachment. The university is a private, non-profit institution on Thika Road in Ruaraka, Nairobi, founded in 1989 as Kenya College of Accountancy by ICPAK.

item.description: Native Camp, a Japan-based online English service, hires home-based English teachers to give lessons through its own platform. item.description: Storetasker is recruiting freelance Shopify developers and boutique agencies to work remotely with e-commerce clients, choosing their own projects and sending their own quotes. item.description: ZanaAfrica Foundation is hiring a Finance Associate. The organization supports adolescent girls in Kenya to stay in school through reproductive health education and the provision of sanitary pads.

item.description: Oracom Group is hiring a Junior Digital Marketer in Kenya. The company is a web design firm with operations in Kenya, Canada and Belgium, over 8 years of experience, and teams of web developers working day and night shifts.

item.description: Absa Bank Limited is hiring a La Riba Universal Banker for the Coast region. The role focuses on delivering a strong customer experience and growing Islamic Banking business and profitability across the branch network.

item.description: The receptionist greets patients and visitors, gives directions and information, and supports anxious patients. The role coordinates patient check-ins and check-outs, notifies clinical staff when patients arrive, and books and reschedules appointments using hospital systems.

item.title: Zeytoon Lounge Jobs – Supervisors and Stewards - Zeytoon Lounge (Nairobi)
item.description: Zeytoon Lounge, on USIU Road behind Safari Mall in Safari Park off Thika Road, Nairobi, is hiring for hospitality and entertainment roles. Supervisor and Steward positions are open, and applicants for each must have relevant experience.
